text: Seabrook Town gewann ein spannendes Spiel gegen Harbour City mit 4:2. Trotz eines roten Platzverweises für Joon Whitfield bei Harbour City spielten sie bis zur 47. Minute gut und lagen durch Tore von Elias Okafor und Marek Barros vorn. Die beiden späten Treffer von Kian Romano in der Nachspielzeit entschieden jedoch die Partie, wobei der erste ein Kontertor und der zweite ein klassisches Tor nach kurzem Passspiel war [#905] [#975] [#1882] [#1906]. Seabrook Town nutzte eine geschickte Umstellung ab der 65. Minute und setzte auf höhere Pressingintensität und direktere Spielweise, was ihnen mehr Chancen brachte und den Gegner immer mehr unter Druck setzte [#1361]. Die Statistiken zeigen, dass Seabrook mit 22 Schüssen und einer erwarteten Torquote (xG) von 3,48 deutlich aktiver und gefährlicher war als Harbour City mit 10 Schüssen und einem xG von 1,0, was bedeutet, dass sie deutlich mehr gute Chancen hatten.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in de

- Seabrook Town won the match 4-2 against Harbour City. [#all goals]
- Marek Barros scored for Harbour City with an xG of 0.009 from a 43.9m cross. [#975]
- Kian Romano scored two late goals for Seabrook Town in stoppage time with high xG values of 0.609 and 0.959. [#1882, #1906]
- Harbour City had 10 shots with 5 on target and an xG of 1.0, while Seabrook Town had 22 shots with 9 on target and an xG of 3.48. [#team_stats]
- Joon Whitfield of Harbour City received a red card at 43' which impacted the game. [#871]

- Seabrook Town scored a crucial goal at 53' immediately following a "regain" with no passes and quick shot by Tariq Marlowe, reflecting a direct counter-attacking moment where ball recovery led to an immediate opportunity. This aligns with Seabrook's 3-4-3 formation and style emphasizing wide crossing and quicker transitions [#1103,1104].

- The turning point came with Seabrook's tactical change at 65' to press higher and play more direct, increasing their press intensity (press: 0.66 to 0.84), directness (0.42 to 0.57), and line height (0.6 to 0.72). This resulted in them reducing their field tilt and box touches temporarily but eventually produced further attacking chances, showing adaptation to chasing the game by applying more pressure and speeding up play for overloads or quicker ball progression [#1361].

- Late goals by Kian Romano at 90+2' and 90+3' came from a counter (short sequence after ball recovery led to quick through ball assists) and an open play goal off short passes respectively, highlighting Seabrook's capacity for efficient transitional play and exploiting space behind the Harbour City's defense pressed high in a 4-2-3-1 formation focused on patient short passing [#1881,1882,1905,1906].

- Harbour City's style of patient short passing and a 4-2-3-1 formation allowed them to build a prolonged 17-pass sequence leading to their first goal at 45', showcasing controlled build-up play. However, their higher PPDA (7.6 overall) and fewer box touches compared to Seabrook indicate less aggressive pressing, which Seabrook exploited with direct counter-attacks and quick transitions [#904,905].
